calls.head: Seattle can’t afford to take penalties
calls.body: Seattle’s penalty kill sits 27th of 32, and Vegas’s power play is 2nd (8.9 expected goals per 60).
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: Vegas’s power play created 11.8 expected goals per 60 in 5:50 of 5-on-4 time, against its usual 8.9, and scored 2 goals.

calls.head: Vegas’s shot volume meets a soft spot
calls.body: Vegas ranks 9th of 32 for shot volume (59.2 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Seattle ranks 32nd for shot suppression.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: Vegas took 69.0 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against its usual 59.2.

SEA.head: We gave Seattle only a 30% chance, and it went the way we feared.

VGK.head: We gave Vegas a 70% chance, and Vegas delivered.
